notes.title: Patch Note: Improvements and Critical Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!
We've fixed many bugs and improved some menus; we hope you enjoy the game!

Update:

Menu - Improved menu ergonomics

Settings - Enhanced language selection

Blessing Selection - Confirmation added to skip blessing

Freeze - Improved freezing feedback
Freeze - Enhanced thermometer

Tesla Torrent - Increased range, now hits medium-range enemies

Queen Autumn - 0.25 damage per second instead of 0.5

Fixes:

Tutorial - Unable to pass the first area
Tutorial - Cannon tower not killing one of the zombie bees, causing loss
Tutorial - Modified blessings available in the tutorial
Tutorial - Unlocking achievements after completing the tutorial

Division Event - Enemy multiplying until game crashes
Division Event - Clicking retry spawns enemies before game start

Queen & Artisan Selection - Descriptions with different formatting
Queen & Artisan Selection - Winter Queen with incomplete description
Queen & Artisan Selection - First queen selection with incorrect character

Arena - Enemy counter showing incorrect numbers

Artisan Unlock - Beefun was not unlockable

Hexagon Map - Re-entering chest hexagons after collecting caused noise again
Hexagon Map - Unable to move on the map after declining a Blessing
Hexagon Map - Map enemies not moving after choosing a blessing or leaving an arena

Artisan - Thriller bee effect changed from enemy to torrent

Queen - Soldier passive inconsistent
Queen - Soldier active not functioning correctly

We're continuing to work on more game additions; soon, there will be different map difficulties, card and blessing previews, new maps, and more... It's getting better and better.

If you have ideas for new implementations in the game, feel free to share on discord or in the steam discussion. We're preparing new blessings, so it might be your chance to see your blessing in the game!

notes.title: Patch Note: Fix for "口" and Critical Errors
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!! Yesterday, on 11/02, we fixed a lot of things, and this is the Fixlog for some of the updates. If you find anything while playing, don’t hesitate to start a discussion in the community or let us know on Discord.

Fixes:

Localization: Fixed "口" symbols in languages like Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, etc.

Achievement: Boss achievements not unlocking
Achievement: Achievements only unlock when exiting the game

Enemy: Trojan not moving and breaking the map
Enemy: Thor combat not completing
Enemy: Enemies summoned by Rabbeet not moving
Enemy: Summoning eggs not displaying correctly
Enemy: Enemies stop spawning

Queen Selection: Fixed image masks

Hexagon Map: "Surrender" button not working on some maps
Hexagon Map: Egg hunt in the candy map not functioning properly

Blessing Selection: Right-side blessing disappearing

Arena: Queen info in the tutorial map displaying in the wrong position
Arena: Boss name animation breaking at certain resolutions

Blessing: Errors when blessings were removed
Blessing: "Stun" blessing not working

Update:

Arena: Visual adjustments to the Chocolate Arena

Added:

Hexagon Map: Heart loss animation

Known Issues:
Chance of crash after completing the tutorial
Cannon displaying next hologram

If you encounter any bugs, open a report in the discussions or join us on Discord, we’re always watching!!

notes.title: First Day Launch Update
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to finally make this game available to you, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!!

As always, we’re working hard to fix any bugs found to provide the best experience possible. So if you encounter any bugs, malfunctioning mechanics, or have any suggestions that you think would improve the game, please open a topic in the discussions tab or join us on our Discord—we're always available there!

Fixes:

Sound: General Sound Improvements
Sound: Sound Settings Fix
Sound: Added New Sounds
Sound: Fixed Sound When Skipping Dialogue

Localization: Text Overflowing Boxes Depending on Language
Localization: Fixed Texts with  Tags
Localization: Updated Fonts for Languages (Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.)

Achievements: Event Wins Unlocking for All Players

Turret: Range Display Missing

Map: Unlocking Maps Even After Losing

Hex Map: Misaligned Tower and Enemy Information on Victory/Defeat Screens
Hex Map: Tower and Enemy Lists Not Scrolling on Victory/Defeat Screens
Hex Map: Hex Selection Disabled When Paused

Blessing Selection: Reject Button Freezing Player
Blessing Selection: Blessing Disappearing
Blessing Selection: Removed Reject Button in Tutorial

Arena: Retry Incorrectly Starting Arena

Update:

Settings Button Added to All Screens

Arena: New Victory Screen Images
Arena: Victory Screen Localization
Arena: Heartbreaking Animation Added

Hex Map: Heartbreaking Animation Added

Enemies: Honey Beender VFX

Known Issues:
Potential Crash When Winning the Tutorial
Enemies Stop Spawning
Blessings Activating Without Being Collected
Cannon Showing Next Hologram

If you encounter any bugs, please open a discussion or join our Discord—we’re always keeping an eye out!
